safe_application_snippets.resume_bullet: Built Tiny Stories, an applied AI story-game runtime that turns rough prompts into playable sessions using typed Story Brief contracts, live LLM generation, persisted sessions, and reviewer-only observability.
safe_application_snippets.sop_sentence: Tiny Stories is the project where I learned to treat LLM product behavior as an engineering system: typed contracts, live-gated execution, telemetry, failure taxonomy, reviewer evidence, and player-facing UX boundaries all had to work together before I could call a demo reliable.
safe_application_snippets.headline: Tiny Stories: a live LLM story-game runtime with typed contracts, evaluator traces, and reviewer-only observability.
